_about: Delivery facts per shop, used when a shop's feed doesn't say how fast it delivers. Shops are found automatically from your Awin feed list; you never need to add a shop here for it to appear. Only add a line to correct or confirm its delivery speed. 'match' is a lowercase piece of the shop's name in Awin. speed: today | tomorrow | later. cutoff: last order hour for today (London time). Checked 24 Nov 2026.
